scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && python -m venv venv && call venv\Scripts\activate && pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && call venv\Scripts\activate && uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 7005
